from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageChops, ImageStat
from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
src=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448.png')
dst=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_rotated_cw0p5_cross_bisectors_vertical_plus20px_2px.png')
with Image.open(src) as im:
    clean=im.convert('RGB')
assert clean.size==(1448,1448),clean.size
rotated=clean.rotate(-0.5,resample=Image.Resampling.BICUBIC,expand=False,fillcolor='white')
out=rotated.copy()
mask=Image.new('L',(1448,1448),0)
draw=ImageDraw.Draw(out)
mdraw=ImageDraw.Draw(mask)
BLACK=(0,0,0)
def line(box):
    draw.rectangle(box,fill=BLACK)
    mdraw.rectangle(box,fill=255)
line((0,723,1447,724))
line((723,0,724,1447))
bands=[]
for offset in range(20,721,20):
    x=723+offset
    line((x,0,x+1,1447))
    bands.append((offset,x,x+1))
assert len(bands)==36,len(bands)
assert bands[0]==(20,743,744),bands[0]
assert bands[-1]==(720,1443,1444),bands[-1]
assert ImageChops.difference(out,rotated).convert('L').getbbox() is not None
outside=ImageChops.multiply(ImageChops.difference(out,rotated).convert('L'),ImageChops.invert(mask))
assert outside.getbbox() is None,'Pixels outside 2px bands changed'
assert out.crop((0,723,1448,725)).getextrema()==((0,0),(0,0),(0,0))
for start in [723]+[x for _,x,_ in bands]:
    assert out.crop((start,0,start+2,1448)).getextrema()==((0,0),(0,0),(0,0)),start
assert out.size==(1448,1448)
out.save(dst,format='PNG',compress_level=6)
with Image.open(dst) as saved:
    assert saved.size==(1448,1448)
    assert ImageChops.difference(saved.convert('RGB'),out).getbbox() is None
print('SOURCE',src,'SOURCE_SIZE',clean.size,flush=True)
print('ROTATION','clockwise 0.5 degrees, bicubic, no expansion, white fill',flush=True)
print('GRID','all 2 pixels thick, 20 pixels center-to-center, horizontal rows 723-724, vertical center cols 723-724, right_count',len(bands),flush=True)
print('FIRST_RIGHT',bands[0],'LAST_RIGHT',bands[-1],flush=True)
print('VERIFICATION','exact black line bands; pixel-identical to clean rotated source outside bands; written PNG readback identical',flush=True)
print('OUTPUT',dst,'BYTES',dst.stat().st_size,'SHA256',sha256(dst.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)
PY
